newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai sells out of 80,000 Deng posters.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai sells out of 80,000 Deng posters.

text.p: Shanghai's state-run bookshops sold out their total stock of 80,000 posters of the late leader Deng Xiaoping on Monday, one day ahead of his funeral, officials said on Monday.
Some people buying posters in the official Xinhua bookstores said they had been queuing two hours for the posters, priced at 3.50 yuan ($0.42) each.
"We have sold out 80,000 of Deng's posters today, 3,000 of which were brought from Beijing by air," one bookstore official said.
"Posters of Deng are out of stock in many bookstores and we are trying our best to arrange supplies to meet the demand," an official of the city's Bureau of Press and Publication said.

Many of the posters were bought by organisations and companies that plan to place them on their walls for mourning ceremonies to coincide with the funeral in Beijing at 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday morning.
